latest_update: Published the R120 Noether record as 10.5281/zenodo.20818060. RA25-RA34 remain the current Paper 02 source-audit correction stream; RA29 closes the Paper 02 body through printed pp.84-90 at the current page-level standard, RA31 source-checks Tabelle I on printed/source p.91, and RA33/RA34 source-check Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 at plate-row level.
